story: [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie is playing in a big pink castle. Sophie has a sparkly crown on her head. The crown has three red stones on the top. Sophie puts the crown on the chair. The crown falls behind the chair! [emotion:QT/surprised] Sophie's friend Ruby is sitting on the floor. Ruby reaches under the chair and finds the crown. Ruby puts the crown back in Sophie's hands. Sophie and Ruby are smiling. [emotion:QT/happy] The two friends sit together and play with the crowns and the bright ribbons.
